chapter: Quality Serenaders, Cotton Club and union recollections
title: Hearing Mamie Smith as a boy in Steubenville
summary: Howard saw Mamie Smith in a Steubenville theater at ten or twelve with just a pianist, and she inspired him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens
